limitations: Fifteen selected scenarios cannot exhaust every edge case.
Controlled delivery tests do not establish a real rescue-team handoff.
Contact evidence establishes published information, not reachability or pickup availability.
The public deployment was not used; a copy of the current local configured index was used.
A named college or general phone is not by itself proof of a clinical service; service claims require separate fetched evidence.
Persona coverage is limited: child/Hindi/elder/fear scenarios were exercised, but teacher and donor dialogue quality was not independently established.
Coverage is mainly English plus one Hindi scenario, not all Indian languages or districts.
This sample does not establish performance under concurrent production load or a model-output failure rate.
Source validation does not impose an official-domain-only allowlist; source quality still requires review.
Retained earlier attempts include failures and weaker answers produced before fixes and with earlier model settings.
The final bounded Aizawl lookup took 53.084 seconds. Production latency/concurrency targets have not been validated.

summary.interpretation: Selected acceptance criteria only. Latest responses are reported alongside all retained attempts; this is not a reliability percentage or comprehensive certification.
summary.rerun_method: Affected scenarios were rerun after targeted fixes; original preceding turns were restored for conversational reruns. The complete 15-case sequence was not rerun after every small change.

changes: Source-bound locality matching tolerates punctuation and whitespace variations without accepting an absent location.
A refined partial is retained when it preserves validated facts and adds a valid phone or fuller address. Clinical adequacy remains false without service evidence.
post_live_fixes.effect_on_report: Latest generated responses and their verdicts are unchanged. These final changes are offline-tested, not another live success.
